name: cloro
summary: Structured answers and sources from ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Mode, Bing AI Mode, Google Search and Google News, by country.

api_key.description: a cloro API key (dashboard.cloro.dev/api-keys); one key grants every endpoint

notes: cloro runs real browser sessions against each AI engine, so calls take longer than a normal API; use the async endpoints for volume.

Credits per call: ChatGPT 5, Gemini 4, Perplexity 4, AI Mode 4, Bing AI Mode 4, Google Search 3, Google News 3, product panel 1; sync /v1/monitor/* calls add +2 on top, async calls do not. Read X-Credits-Charged on a sync answer for the exact charge.
Answers are wrapped as {success, result}; result holds the text, sources and provider-specific blocks.
Country is required on most endpoints and there is no default. List supported codes with cloro.meta.countries.

endpoints.name: Ask ChatGPT
endpoints.summary: ChatGPT's answer to a prompt with cited sources, shopping cards, entities and optionally ads, from a chosen country.

prompt.description: The prompt, or an array of up to 5 prompts for a multi-turn chat (then result is an array).
prompt.example: What are the best running shoes for flat feet?

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to run from.

state.description: US state code for sub-country targeting, such as CA; only with country US. Costs +2 credits.

include.description: Optional flags for extra response data, such as {"markdown": true}. Each provider's flags are listed on its docs page.

legacy.description: Ask for ChatGPT's legacy desktop interface; best-effort and temporary.

disableWebSearch.description: Do not force web search; ChatGPT then usually answers without sources.

notes: A read over POST: cloro runs a real browser session against the AI engine and returns the answer; nothing on your account changes except credits.
Costs 5 credits base, +2 once for any of rawResponse, searchQueries, ads or shopping, +1 per extra prompt, plus the +2 sync surcharge.

endpoints.name: Google Search results
endpoints.summary: Google organic results, ads, People Also Ask, related searches, local pack and, optionally, the AI Overview.

query.description: The search query, 1-10,000 characters. Needed unless url is set.

url.description: A full Google web search URL to run instead of query and the targeting fields.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to run from.

gl.description: Alternative to country, using Google's own gl name. Same codes.

hl.description: Interface language, such as en, de or pt-BR.

uule.description: Pre-encoded UULE location; use instead of location.

pages.description: Result pages to scrape, 1-10. Each page after the first costs +2 credits.

include.description: Extra data flags: html, aioverview (optionally {"markdown": true}) and paaAioverview.

notes: A read over POST: cloro runs a real browser session against the AI engine and returns the answer; nothing on your account changes except credits.
Costs 3 credits base, +2 once for AI Overview, +2 per extra page, plus the +2 sync surcharge. Send country or gl, or a url that has gl; there is no default country.
Do not pass tbm; use the Google News endpoint.

endpoints.name: Create an async task
endpoints.summary: Queue one provider request to run in the background; returns a task id to poll.

payload.description: The provider's request body, the same as its sync endpoint (country or gl required).

example.prompt: What do you know about Acme Corp?

idempotencyKey.description: Unique string that stops duplicate tasks.

notes: Starts a billed job: it only produces data and changes nothing else in your account.
Poll cloro.async.get_task with the returned id.
No +2 sync surcharge on async requests, so each is 2 credits cheaper than the sync call.

endpoints.name: Get an async task
endpoints.summary: State and, once finished, the full result of an async task.
notes: The finished task reports creditsCharged.

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
endpoints.summary: Credit balance and billing cycle for your organization.
notes: The balance is cached and can lag by up to 60 seconds.

endpoints.name: List supported countries
endpoints.summary: ISO country codes cloro supports, optionally for one provider.
